FIELD MANUAL / READ WHILE SOBER

A brief briefing.

Fly & fight
Drag anywhere in the battlefield. Your ship follows the drag without jumping. Guns fire automatically. On a keyboard, use WASD or arrows.
Power at a price
Bottles raise damage and fire rate, but add momentum, spread, and recoil. Readiness fades naturally. Pickups labeled REPAIR, SHIELD, XP, or +$1B help without the hangover.
Emergency funding
SELL BONDS trades score for cash, even below zero. BURN $1B launches 14 homing missiles in a wide emergency salvo. The launch blast clears nearby hostile shots; missile explosions destroy hostile ships and open space. Missiles are purchased here, not found as pickups or regular upgrades. Keyboard: B sells bonds; Space launches the salvo.
Watch the politics
Debt drains Imperial patience. Run out and your own fleet turns on you. Recover to +1,000 and rebuild patience to regain favor. A red HOSTILE label means a former ally can be shot.
Orders are real
The Emperor may reverse the war, change allegiances, confiscate cash, or impose faulty weapons. Changes have a warning window. When his gold ship arrives, score 3–12 kills to help without taking his credit.
Take a break
PLAY FULLSCREEN on the title enters fullscreen and deploys. You can also enter or exit fullscreen from Pause. The segmented HULL bar at the battlefield edge shows remaining life; empty segments mean damage. Pause with II, P, or Escape. Leaving the app pauses combat. M toggles sound. Records and settings save on this device when storage is available.
